summary: Iteration 19: tested the MindMellow programme (Class 11-12) end to end, plus EquiMind regression. New pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mindmellow.py: 17/19 pass. The 2 failures are real gaps that let one programme see the other's data (counsellor side). I found and fixed one bug: wellness/today and wellness/reads ignored the MindMellow area mapping. Frontend: every requested flow works. Landing, login lists, the lavender/peach/teal palettes, switching between EquiMind and MindMellow, Diya/Aarav dashboards (check-in popup dismissed with 'Remind me later', nothing submitted), the Aarav report (Week 1, Week 2 and Next Steps present; '2-subject rule', 'School counsellor', MindMellow footer, lilac/wisteria/violet/plum/dusk tones, MindMellow-Report-Aarav-Shah.pdf) and the Diya report (Week 1 only). Kabir's new check-in had 24 MindMellow statements and produced a report with version 'MindMellow v4.0' and an AI narrative; I then re-ran the seed script and Kabir's new report got the 5 low-mood days. Neha sees only Aarav/Diya/Kabir (all 3 flagged), and her student detail page works. Kavya sees only the EquiMind students. Admin: the switch changes Overview, Question bank (180 items, A2-01 present), Activities and the Product Document card/link; the MindMellow doc page has 180 codes and downloads MindMellow_Product_Document.md. Rohan's report is still blue with EquiMind content and downloads EquiMind-Report-Rohan-Verma.pdf.

critical.issue: Not filtered by programme. MindMellow counsellor mm-neha sees EquiMind bookings (stu-meera, stu-ananya) in 'Sessions & requests' (API and UI). It should only return bookings whose student programme matches the counsellor's (or counsellor_id == user.id).

A counsellor can read any report: the query is {id: rid} with no programme check. cou-kavya gets 200 on Aarav's MindMellow report 3520670c... Fix: look up the report owner and require owner.programme == counsellor.programme.

minor.issue: No programme or counsellor check: any counsellor can update or cancel the other programme's bookings.
slot_id is not checked against the student's programme: a MindMellow student could book an EquiMind counsellor's slot by id (and the reverse).
The student name lookup spans all students. It works, but it is not scoped by programme.

FIXED by testing agent: _latest_report projection left out 'programme', so the MindMellow WELLNESS_MAP never ran (Kabir got F,E,D instead of B,C,D). Added 'programme': 1 to the projection in server.py.

integration_issues.issue: Shows EquiMind students' bookings (Ananya, Meera) because of the backend sessions leak
